summary: Hand-built `listings get <id>` and `listings count` as novel commands wired under the generated `listings` parent via a registerNovelCommand hook; removed the corresponding spec endpoints.
reason: The generator's GraphQL-endpoint path (graphqlPayloadParams) emits only operationName/query/variables and cannot bind a positional (job id) or filter flags into the query variables, so the spec-emitted `listings get`/`count` returned HTTP 400 / unknown-flag at runtime.
validated_outcome: listings get 94483533 and listings count --keywords ... --where ... both return real data live; covered by the Phase 5 matrix.
